question: According to NACO guidelines, co-trimoxazole prophylaxis (for PCP and toxoplasmosis) should be initiated in all PLHIV with a CD4 count below 350 cells/μL.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is false. Co-trimoxazole prophylaxis is triggered at CD4 < 200 cells/μL for PCP prevention, not 350 cells/μL. It is also indicated in all WHO Stage 3 or 4 patients. The 350 cells/μL threshold is associated with ART initiation policy (historical), not OI prophylaxis.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct — the statement is false. NACO guidelines recommend co-trimoxazole prophylaxis when CD4 < 200 cells/μL (for PCP), or in all patients with WHO Stage 3 or Stage 4 disease regardless of CD4 count. The threshold of 350 cells/μL is not the correct trigger.
